QuestInfo.name: [Maple Friends] Getting Signatures
QuestInfo.0: Wonder how long your friends have been traveling Maple World? #p9010000# says she has a way you can enjoy the festivities of the 9th Anniversary with your friends.
QuestInfo.1:
#p9010000# says that getting the signature of a player who has been with MapleStory #r#efor more than a year#k#n will earn you #e#bFriend Points (FP)#k#n. The more Friend Points you get, the better the gifts you will receive. 
The longer the player has been with MapleStory, the more points you will get for their signature.
#e<How to Obtain Friend Points (FP)>#n
1) Right-click on the character whose signature you wish to obtain.
2) Select #r'Get Maple Signature'#k.
QuestInfo.2:
The longer a player has been with MapleStory, the more points you will get for their signature. Collect Friend Points to get a #e#bMaple Friend Gift#k#n.
#e<How to Obtain Friend Points (FP)>#n
1) Right-click on the character whose signature you wish to obtain.
2) Select #r'Get Maple Signature'#k.

0.0: Okay, here's how to get #e#bFriend Points (FP)#k#n.\nCollect the signatures of other players, and you'll get FP. You only get #r10 chances per day#k, and they can only be obtained from #rcharacters with the Maple Friend icon#k. Also, you can only give your signature to #r20 other characters each day#k.
0.1: You'll understand better once you try it out. Remember, the longer the character has been in Maple World, the more #bFriend Points (FP)#k you'll get.

yes.0: #i3800500#\nFirst, find someone with a #eMaple Friend#n icon in front of their name. Then #eright-click#n your #emouse#n while hovering over them, and select the #r#eGet Maple Signature#k#n option.
yes.1: #i3800501#\nYou'll then send a signature request to that character. When they press the [O] button, the signature window will open.
yes.2: Then, when you click on #e[Get Signature]#n and they click on #e[Give Signature]#n, you'll get both the signature and your Friend Points (FP)!\n#i3800502#
yes.3:
Now for the fine print... 

#e#b<Restrictions>#k#n
1. You can only receive one signature per account.
2. You can only receive signatures from up to 10 characters each day.
3. Signatures can only be given out 20 times per day per character.
4. The older the Maple Friend, the more points you will get.
yes.4: I suggest going somewhere a lot of people are gathered, like a town or the Free Market.

no.0: This'll be a fun way for you to meet new people!

1.0: Easy, right? Continue to collect Friend Points (FP) to exchange for a special gift.\n

yes.0: I hope you make lots of great friends here in Maple World!
